project_type: Python CLI + Streamlit web app. Backend modules are plain Python files (no framework). Web layer is Streamlit. SQLite via stdlib sqlite3.
build_system: No compilation. All modules are plain .py files. pip install -r requirements.txt is the only setup step.
test_framework: pytest 7.4+. Run from lcc_system/ with: python -m pytest tests/ -v
verification_instructions: 1. cd lcc_system/. 2. pip install -r requirements.txt. 3. python -m pytest tests/ -v — ALL tests (old + new) must pass. 4. streamlit run webapp/app.py — browser opens, register/login/chat works. 5. python demo.py — still exits 0 with ≥1 [DECISION] line.
snapshot_or_generated_files: lcc_system/webapp/lcc_webapp.db is created at runtime by database.py. Do NOT commit it. Add to .gitignore.
environment_constraints: NEVER modify any file under lcc_system/src/ or any existing file under lcc_system/tests/. NEVER restart or kill the Streamlit dev server from code. No hardcoded API keys. bcrypt and streamlit are the only new dependencies. SQLite via stdlib sqlite3 only — no SQLAlchemy.
contribution_requirements: New files go in lcc_system/webapp/ and lcc_system/tests/ (new test files only). requirements.txt updated in-place (append lines, do not rewrite existing content). README updated with Streamlit run instructions.
key_patterns: All existing modules import each other with bare names (no package prefix) because conftest.py inserts lcc_system/src/ into sys.path. webapp/ modules must do the same: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent.parent / 'src')) at the top of each file that imports src/ modules. DatasetLoader, MedicationNormalizer, EvidenceRetriever are constructed once per Streamlit session using st.cache_resource. StateManager must be constructed fresh per conversation (case_id = str(conversation_id)). PatientState serialization uses dataclasses.asdict() for writing to JSON columns in SQLite, and manual reconstruction via ClinicalFact(**d) / PatientState(**{...}) for reading back.
directory_structure: lcc_system/ is the Python project root. lcc_system/src/ holds all backend modules (read-only for this task). lcc_system/tests/ holds existing pytest files (read-only) and new test files. lcc_system/webapp/ is the new directory: __init__.py, database.py, auth.py, pipeline.py, app.py. lcc_system/webapp/lcc_webapp.db is the runtime SQLite file (not committed). Raw datasets in sibling dirs are read-only.

critical_interfaces.StateExtractor.extract_from_turn: Takes ConversationTurn object (NOT a plain string). Construct: ConversationTurn(turn_index=turn_idx, speaker='patient', text=user_message, revealed_evidence_ids=[], injection={})
critical_interfaces.CoherenceVerifier.__init__: CoherenceVerifier(state_manager: StateManager, evidence_retriever: EvidenceRetriever, normalizer: MedicationNormalizer) — three positional args
critical_interfaces.CoherenceVerifier.verify: verify(response_text, evidence_used: list[EvidenceRecord], turn_index: int, conversation: Conversation) -> list[CoherenceFlag]
critical_interfaces.DecisionGate.evaluate: evaluate(flags: list[CoherenceFlag]) -> tuple[str, str]  — returns (decision_str, reasoning_str), NOT VerificationResult
critical_interfaces.DatasetLoader.get_all_data: returns dict with keys: cases, dailymed, concepts, relationships, aliases, conditions, evidences
critical_interfaces.StateManager: StateManager(case_id: str). .update(turn_index, new_facts) -> PatientState; .get_current_state() -> PatientState; .get_contradictions() -> list
critical_interfaces.PatientState_fields: case_id, version, turn_number, timestamp, facts: dict[str,ClinicalFact], revealed_evidence_ids: list[str], medications: list[str]
critical_interfaces.ClinicalFact_fields: fact_id, description, status, source_turn, timestamp, confidence, is_antecedent
critical_interfaces.Conversation_dataclass: Conversation(case_id: str, turns: list[ConversationTurn], current_turn: int)
critical_interfaces.ConversationTurn_dataclass: ConversationTurn(turn_index: int, speaker: str, text: str, revealed_evidence_ids: list[str], injection: dict)
